description: A small Workspace for the example questions: short summaries of some files of .ai/memory, with their supersede relations. The integration test writes it to both stacks. The validity window of a unit applies to the document and to its claims.

units.title: ADR-003: Drizzle ORM beta (v1.x)
units.body: Status: Accepted. The backend uses the beta dist-tag of drizzle-orm and drizzle-kit and follows the v1 API.

units.title: ADR-004: Local development with Docker Compose
units.body: Status: Superseded by ADR-015. Local development runs Postgres and the graph database with one Docker Compose file and no profiles.

units.title: ADR-010: OpenCypher graph database and FalkorDB as default
units.body: Status: Accepted, to be superseded by ADR-066 when all orgs use ClickHouse. The knowledge graph uses OpenCypher, and FalkorDB is the default graph database.

units.title: ADR-015: Docker Compose profiles and small-scale container deploy
units.body: Status: Accepted. One docker-compose.yml uses profiles. pnpm dev:infra starts the infra profile, and pnpm start starts the deploy profile.

units.title: ADR-017: Amplitude analytics (UI and backend)
units.body: Status: Superseded by ADR-038. Product analytics and observability events go to Amplitude from the UI and the backend.

units.title: ADR-021: Local agent memory with repo Markdown and AgentMemory hydrated cache
units.body: Status: Superseded by ADR-024. Coding agents keep memory in repo Markdown, and an AgentMemory cache with an MCP proxy serves it.

units.title: ADR-024: Markdown-only local memory with candidate-first capture
units.body: Status: Accepted. Durable agent memory is Markdown only under .ai/memory. A hook captures candidates first. There are no embeddings and no memory MCP.

units.title: ADR-029: Railway compute in US East next to Neon
units.body: Status: Superseded by ADR-061. The hosted compute runs on Railway in US East, next to the Neon database, for low latency.

units.title: ADR-038: Self-hosted ClickStack and Langfuse (ops observability)
units.body: Status: Superseded by ADR-061. Ops observability runs on a self-hosted ClickStack and Langfuse on Railway.

units.title: ADR-039: Production image deploys stay on one Railway environment
units.body: Status: Superseded by ADR-061. Production image deploys stay on one Railway environment.

units.title: ADR-056: Oxlint and Oxfmt replace Biome
units.body: Status: Accepted. Oxlint and Oxfmt replace Biome: one Oxc parser for lint and format, checked in CI.

units.title: ADR-061: Hosted ctxpipe on AWS (us-west-2) behind Cloudflare
units.body: Status: Proposed. Hosted ctxpipe runs on AWS in us-west-2 behind Cloudflare, with Aurora, AgentCore sandboxes and HyperDX only for observability.

units.title: ADR-066: Knowledge content lives in ClickHouse
units.body: Status: Accepted. Knowledge documents, chunks and relations live in ClickHouse. Postgres keeps the operational data. Org isolation is a WHERE clause and a row policy.

units.title: ADR-067: The knowledge projection applies the Git diff
units.body: Status: Accepted. The knowledge projection applies the Git diff from last_sha, replaces each changed document, and keeps the current state only.

units.title: Project glossary
units.body: Hydrate: a read-only rebuild of the projection from a workspace-repository tree; it never writes the workspace repository. Projection: the derived retrieval state of one SHA.
